name: The Missing Shipment
summary: At Ratchet’s docks, Dizzywig’s ledger points away from harbor graft and toward the Southsea Freebooters. Gazlowe receives the records and prepares to reclaim his lost cargo.

sections.title: Books Balanced at the Docks
sections.body: Ratchet’s trade and its port bring constant logistical headaches. When a shipment fails to arrive, Gazlowe suspects bad harbor accounts or foul play on the piers. Wharfmaster Dizzywig examines the manifest and insists his books are clean. The intake records account for everything, so the missing merchandise never made it onto the dock.

sections.title: Eyes on the Freebooters
sections.body: With Dizzywig clearing the port’s own operations of embezzlement, the Southsea Freebooters camped down the coast remain the plausible culprits. Dizzywig returns the ledger and mentions separate crates waiting from Undermine. He sends you back to Gazlowe, Ratchet’s chief engineer. Convinced of Dizzywig’s loyalty, Gazlowe turns from supply ledgers to organizing an expedition to reclaim his stolen booty.

faq.answer: Gazlowe’s ledger holds shipping manifests, cargo inventories, and port intake logs for goods arriving in Ratchet. Dizzywig reviews the records to see whether the missing crates were checked in from the ships.
Gazlowe suspects the Southsea Freebooters, pirates camped along the coast south of Ratchet. Dizzywig’s records show no discrepancy at the docks, so Gazlowe turns his attention to the raiders.

faq.q: Why does Gazlowe trust Wharfmaster Dizzywig?
faq.answer: Gazlowe trusts Dizzywig, who is on his payroll and has served him reliably. Gazlowe believes the wharfmaster knows better than to cheat him and accepts his word that the books are clean.

faq.q: What are the items from Undermine that Dizzywig mentions?
faq.answer: Dizzywig mentions separate goods from Undermine, the goblin capital, waiting for Gazlowe to collect when he has a moment away from managing the town.

faq.q: Where does this investigation lead next?
faq.answer: Returning the ledger to Gazlowe leads to Stolen Booty. You are hired to infiltrate the Southsea Freebooter camps along the southern coast of the Barrens and take back the lost cargo.
Wharfmaster Dizzywig oversees the Ratchet docks, near the pier platforms where merchant vessels load and unload their cargo.

angles.text: Harbor paperwork shows how easily goods can vanish between sea and shore, a classic smugglers’ trick.
Ratchet is neutral, and keeping Gazlowe happy helps maintain steady trade routes and goblin neutrality that benefits the Horde.
Operating in the Barrens calls for careful alliances. Helping Ratchet’s leadership supports a reliable foothold in central Kalimdor for the Alliance.
